summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Lowkey Next.js app Home page redesign. All 6 sections verified in correct order, all APIs working, login flow functional. The app successfully implements the 'premium adult social club' design with clean, structured, minimal layout.
critical_code_review_comments: Live Moments section uses MOCKED hardcoded data (not from API) - this is expected per requirements
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded data - 7 lounges and founder account
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Home page redesign features verified working. The 6 sections are in correct order: 1) Featured Lounge (After Dark), 2) Members Online + Stories, 3) New Matches (conditional), 4) Live Moments, 5) Rooms/Lounges (simple list), 6) Quick Access. Bottom navigation has Home/Lounge/After Dark/Profile. Header has credit balance and notification bell. Story creation modal works.

login_flow.details: Login with kinglowkey@hotmail.com / password123 works correctly. Onboarding modal appears on first login and can be dismissed.

section_1_featured_lounge.details: Featured Lounge section exists with 'After Dark' title, 'FEATURED' label, 'Live' indicator, description 'Private. Discreet. For those who want more.', and 'Enter' CTA button

section_2_members_online_stories.details: Members Online + Stories section shows 'Online Now' with green dot count, Add Story button (+ icon), user avatars with green online dots, and story circles

section_3_new_matches.details: New Matches section is conditional - only shows when there are pending friend requests. Currently hidden (no pending requests)

section_4_live_moments.details: Live Moments section shows activity feed with 5 items: 'Someone just joined After Dark', 'New conversation started in Main Lounge', 'Exclusive content was just posted', 'A tip was sent anonymously', '3 new members arrived'. NOTE: This data is MOCKED/hardcoded

section_5_rooms_lounges.details: Rooms section shows lounges in simple list format (NOT heavy cards) with colored accent bars, lounge names, descriptions, member counts, and 'All rooms' link

section_6_quick_access.details: Quick Access section has 5 icons: Inbox (blue), Games (green), Radio (red), Events (amber), Search (purple)

bottom_navigation.details: Bottom navigation has 4 tabs: Home (purple active), Lounge, After Dark, Profile

header_credit_balance.details: Credit balance button in header shows wallet icon with credit count (0)

header_notification_bell.details: Notification bell in header with badge for unread count

story_creation_modal.details: Story creation modal opens when 'Add Story' button clicked. Shows Photo/Video/Text tabs, upload area, privacy options (Everyone/Friends Only), and Share Story button

api_auth_login.details: POST /api/auth/login returns 200 with user object and token

api_users.details: GET /api/users returns 200 with list of users

api_lounges.details: GET /api/lounges returns 200 with list of 7 lounges

mocked_data.live_moments: Live Moments section has hardcoded mock data in page.js (lines 1697-1703) - not fetched from API
